evidence.text: google_logo Play Games Apps Movies & TV Books Kids search help_outline Brass Tap FSC Franchise Co., LLC 2.9 star 105 reviews 10K+ Downloads Install Share Add to wishlist chevron_right About this app arrow_forward The Brass Tap App. We’ve completely upgraded our app while retaining all your favorite capabilities. Browse thousands of beers and discover new ones that match your preferred brew characteristics – including style, ABV, color, clarity, origin and brewery. Set your favorite Brass Tap to create the ultimate shortcut to your Tap’s specific menus, events and specials. You can even start a “Beer Diary” rating and ranking every brew to keep track of all your favs. Tap into your Brew Crew account to check your status and view any rewards you’ve acquired and the beers you’ve tried. Out on the town and planning your next stop? Use the app to find your closest Brass Tap. Download the new Brass Tap app now and see just how rewarding it can be. Updated on Aug 5, 2025 Food & Drink Data safety arrow_forward Safety starts with understanding how developers collect and share your data. Data privacy and security practices may vary based on your use, region, and age. The developer provided this information and may update it over time.
